The framework function is `createGlobalStore` in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-state/src/state.ts`. Three chart modules call it directly. Other chart code reads or writes the stores those modules create, so a behaviour change would reach it too.

**Direct callers in the patient chart**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/store/patient-chart-store.ts` creates `patient-chart-global-store` (line 19). `usePatientChartStore` (lines 55–71) and `setPatientChartWorkspaceGroupVisitUuid` (lines 40–42) depend on it. This is the most exposed case, because the hook's patient-matching guard relies on the store's state being shared and persistent.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/store.ts` creates `order-basket` (line 24). `_resetOrderBasketStore` (lines 29–31) calls `setState` on it.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/app/fe-wrapper/fe-wrapper.component.ts` creates `ampath-form-state` (line 35).

**Consumers of the order basket store**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/useOrderBasket.ts` uses the store in the hook (lines 51–56 and 96–98).
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/postOrders.ts` reads it with `getState()` (lines 15 and 163).
- Tests that seed or reset it: `postOrders.test.ts` (lines 3 and 25), `medications-details-table.test.tsx` (lines 8, 119, 134), and `order-basket-action-button.test.tsx` (lines 8 and 36).

**Not affected at runtime**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/openmrs-esm-framework.mock.ts` (line 12) defines its own stub `createGlobalStore`. It would only drift from the real behaviour and would not change.

**Framework definition**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-state/src/state.ts` lines 61–85. The function returns the existing store when the name is already registered, and logs an error for a duplicate active name outside tests. The behaviour being asked about is in this body.

I did not confirm that every `createGlobalStore` reference in the chart was found, because the local grep covered only the checked-out chart. The line ranges for `useOrderBasket.ts` and the test files come from grep matches, not full reads.
